### Melting Point { #awakening-melting-point }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/netsu/melting_point.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Releases a wave of heat that turns the metal worn by nearby enemies red-hot, burning them every second for a while. The more metal they carry the worse it burns, taking it off or wearing diamond stops it.

### Scorching Fist { #awakening-scorching-fist }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/netsu/scorching_fist.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Gathers the heat of the whole body into the next punch, which explodes on impact and burns everyone around the target. The target is left with several Inferno stacks.
